description: This file defines a class `VoiceWakeTester` used for testing voice wake word detection, managing speech recognition tasks, audio sessions, and handling recognition results with debugging capabilities.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTester
classes.description: A class responsible for performing voice wake word recognition testing, handling permissions, and managing speech recognition lifecycle.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition engine with provided triggers and configuration, and begins listening for the wake words.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Completes recognition and releases audio resources after a timeout.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Processes recognition results, updates state, and handles detection logic.
